description: This file is a shell script that automates testing of git push porcelain output features, including various push scenarios such as force, atomic, dry-run, and hooks, by manipulating repositories, capturing output, and verifying expected behaviors.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns the commit IDs to variable names passed as arguments.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object ID from a full git object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats output of git commands to make commit IDs and other info user-friendly and consistent for comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Filters the output, preparing an 'expect' file for comparison.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Initializes and clones a bare upstream repository with optional configuration.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up both upstream and local workbench repositories, configuring refs and remotes for testing.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for testing HTTP-based git operations.

methods.name: setup_askpass_helper
methods.description: Configures a helper for handling passphrase prompts during tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test routine.
